title: SA/103/2011 of HARISH KUMAR KARNWAL Vs NARENDRA KUMAR and OTHERS

paras.text:
SA No.103/11
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
 Mr. Virendra Kaparwan, Advocate for the appellant.
 Mr. A.M. Saklani, Advocate for respondent no.1.
 On due consideration, urgency application no.3414 of
2014 is allowed.
 Also heard on the merits of petition.
 It transpires that some compensation was awarded by
the Director, Rehabilitation, assisted by other government
agencies, in lieu of the shop which was acquired for the
purpose of Tehri Dam Project. The compensation of Rs.2.00
lakh was awarded to Ratan Lal (father of second appellant) in
lieu of acquisition of that shop. There is a dispute regarding
claiming of share out of this Rs.2.00 lakh by the appellant
whose claim has not been recognized and turned down by
both the courts below.
 Further, there is 244 daysí delay in preferring this
second appeal. However, the Court is not convinced to admit
this appeal since no substantial question of law arises in the
matter.
 Thus, the delay condonation application (CLMA
11388/2011) as also the appeal are dismissed.
 (Stay application no.11389/2011 also stand rejected)
